name: Is decorative millwork suitable for all rooms, including bathrooms and kitchens?

mainEntity.name: Is decorative millwork suitable for all rooms, including bathrooms and kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Decorative millwork can be suitable for most rooms, but material selection is critical for high-moisture areas like bathrooms and kitchens. In these environments, opting for moisture-resistant materials like polyurethane or specific types of treated wood is a crucial decision factor to prevent warping, rot, or mold growth. While solid wood can be used, it requires proper sealing and maintenance to withstand humidity. Avoiding untreated wood in these areas will ensure the longevity and appearance of your millwork.
acceptedAnswer.description: Millwork can be used in all rooms. For bathrooms and kitchens, moisture-resistant materials like polyurethane are critical to prevent damage.
